problem: The sentence says the circuits 'add or subtract fuel', but no carburettor circuit subtracts fuel. The main jet sets the base supply; idle, power valve, accelerator pump and choke only add extra fuel to enrich the mixture.
fix: Change to 'add fuel' or 'add extra fuel'.

problem: The sentence says at part throttle the idle and main circuits both contribute. In most carburettors the idle circuit has largely stopped at normal part throttle; it contributes only at closed or very small throttle openings, where it overlaps with the main circuit.
fix: Say: 'At small throttle openings the idle and main circuits overlap; at larger part throttle the main circuit dominates.'

problem: The symbols mair and mfuel are written without subscripts, unlike the formula itself.
fix: Write m<sub>air</sub> and m<sub>fuel</sub> in the where clause.
